title: The Waterpark
content: I remember pieces of being in the water park area in mallworld the other night. In particular, a strangely familiar part of a lazy river type section, people on floating Tubulars (myself included). A strangely tight tunnel section of the lazy river that is just barely wide and tall enough for people to safely fit through. You don't know whether it's gonna be a steep drop-off type tube or just a lazy ride under the bridge. "The Bridge" being more like an open plaza above the water, with higher up walkways, feels like some sort of open air mall or part of a resort. Then I remember there being an intercom style announcement about people getting to a gathering before it starts. But then I'm somehow in a more unsavory part if the area, with a bunch of tattered homeless placing bets on tickets to "The Event." Then something about running through a half abandoned 80s style apartment complex. One section had some decently beautiful indoor gardens with tall tropical plants in rounded rock planters and fancy glass roof and walls. Yet the next wall over uncovered an odd mix of old wooden dressers and bookcases full of items, and some really odd looking ceramics that somehow felt like they were so delicate that a small breath of wind would turn them to powder. Now that I've written this out, it feels like I was "in Mallworld" and then somehow got jumped back into a personal dreamworld. That or I missed a great party in the Astral last night lol.
